what: Pre-launch checklist for a website. Each item is one thing to verify before going live.

verify.agent: Decidable from the site alone. Follow the recipe and record the result.
verify.shared: Gather the evidence; a person makes the final call.
verify.human: Needs a person. Do not record a result for these.

items.task: No placeholder text anywhere
items.note: Grep the build output for lorem, TODO, FIXME, example.com, Coming soon, @test, and your own scratch words.
items.recipe: Fetch every page in the sitemap and search the HTML for lorem, TODO, FIXME, example.com, 'Coming soon' and @test.

items.task: Every page proofread by a person who did not write it
items.note: Spelling, grammar, and consistent product naming. Machine spellcheck misses the wrong-word-spelled-right class of error entirely.

items.task: Facts, prices, dates and names verified against a source
items.note: Anything numeric, legal, or about a real person. Check copyright years update automatically rather than being hardcoded.

items.task: Every internal and external link resolves
items.note: Crawl the built site rather than clicking. Watch for links to staging hosts, localhost, and unpublished drafts.
items.recipe: Crawl every internal link and confirm a 2xx; request each external link with HEAD.

items.task: Images are the right image, sized and compressed
items.note: Correct crop at every breakpoint, modern format with a fallback, explicit width/height to stop layout shift, and no 4MB hero.
items.recipe: Report images over 300kB, images missing width/height, and formats older than WebP or AVIF.

items.task: Contact details, addresses and social handles are current
items.note: Send a test to every address and phone number that appears on the site. Dead mailboxes lose real enquiries silently.
items.recipe: Extract every mailto:, tel: and social link so a person can confirm each one is live.

items.task: Content that must not be public is not published
items.note: Draft posts, internal notes, client names under embargo, test users, seeded data, source maps and comments left in the markup.
items.recipe: List every URL in the sitemap and search index, and flag drafts, test users and staging hostnames.

items.task: Dates, currency, units and language match the audience
items.note: Including <html lang>, and hreflang if you ship more than one locale.
items.recipe: Check <html lang>, and hreflang if more than one locale is published.

items.task: Automated scan clean on every template
items.note: axe DevTools, Pa11y or Lighthouse across one instance of each layout — not just the homepage. Zero criticals and serious issues.
items.recipe: Run axe or the Lighthouse accessibility audit on one URL per template; report critical and serious issues.

items.task: Whole site operable by keyboard alone
items.note: Tab through every page. Focus order follows reading order, focus is always visible (2.4.11/2.4.13), nothing traps focus, and modals return focus on close.

items.task: Tested with a real screen reader
items.note: VoiceOver + Safari and NVDA + Firefox as a baseline. Listen to a form submission and an error state end to end.

items.task: Colour contrast passes AA
items.note: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text and for UI components and focus indicators (1.4.11). Check both themes and hover/disabled states.
items.recipe: Run an automated contrast audit in both colour schemes, including hover and disabled states.

items.task: Semantic structure and landmarks
items.note: One h1 per page, no skipped heading levels, real <nav>/<main>/<footer>, a skip link, and list markup for lists.
items.recipe: Check for one h1 per page, no skipped heading levels, nav/main/footer landmarks and a skip link.

items.task: Images, icons and media described
items.note: Meaningful alt, empty alt="" for decoration, accessible names on icon-only buttons, captions and transcripts for video and audio.
items.recipe: List images with no alt and icon-only buttons with no accessible name; a person judges whether the text is meaningful.

items.task: Forms labelled, and errors explain the fix
items.note: Every control has a visible label, errors are announced and text-based (not colour alone), and required/format hints appear before submission.
items.recipe: Report controls with no associated label, and errors conveyed by colour alone.

items.task: Zoom, reflow and motion
items.note: 200% zoom and a 320px viewport with no horizontal scroll or clipped content; prefers-reduced-motion honoured; nothing autoplays with sound.
items.recipe: Load at a 320px viewport and at 200% zoom; report horizontal overflow and clipped content.

items.task: Accessibility statement published
items.note: Named standard, known gaps, contact route for problems, and the date last reviewed. Legally required for public sector bodies in the UK and EU.
items.recipe: Find the statement and check it names a standard and version, lists known gaps, gives a contact route for reporting problems, and carries a review date. Report which of those are missing, and whether it is reachable from a stable URL rather than only the footer.

items.task: Content-Security-Policy in enforcing mode
items.note: No unsafe-inline for scripts — use nonces or hashes. Include object-src 'none', base-uri 'self', frame-ancestors, and a report-uri/report-to endpoint you actually watch. Ship in report-only first, then flip.
items.recipe: Read the policy from the response header, and separately from any <meta http-equiv> tag. A meta-delivered policy only applies from the parse point on, and frame-ancestors, sandbox and report-uri are ignored there entirely — report the split if the two disagree. Then reject unsafe-inline in script-src, and require object-src 'none', base-uri, frame-ancestors and a reporting endpoint.

items.task: HSTS with a long max-age
items.note: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, plus preload once you are sure every subdomain is HTTPS-only — preload is slow to undo.
items.recipe: Check strict-transport-security carries a max-age of at least 31536000.

items.task: The rest of the header set
items.note: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy denying camera/mic/geolocation you don't use, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin.
items.recipe: Check for x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy and cross-origin-opener-policy.

items.task: TLS correct and renewing automatically
items.note: Valid chain, TLS 1.2+, HTTP redirects to HTTPS, no mixed content, and a calendar reminder before expiry even with auto-renewal. Grade it with SSL Labs.
items.recipe: Check the certificate chain and expiry, the negotiated TLS version, and that http:// redirects to https://.

items.task: Secrets are not in the bundle or the repo
items.note: Search the built output for keys and tokens. Rotate anything that was ever committed — history is public the moment the repo is.
items.recipe: Search the built JavaScript and the public repo for key-shaped strings; a person confirms and rotates.

items.task: Third-party scripts justified and pinned
items.note: Every embed is a supply chain. Use integrity hashes where you can, self-host where you can't, and delete the ones nobody asked for.
items.recipe: List every external script and frame origin, and whether each carries an integrity hash.

items.task: Cookies and sessions configured
items.note: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite; sensible expiry; CSRF protection on state-changing requests.
items.recipe: Inspect every Set-Cookie for Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite.

items.task: Admin and staging not reachable
items.note: Staging behind auth and noindex, default credentials changed, directory listing off, dependency audit clean, rate limiting on forms and login.
items.recipe: Try likely staging hostnames and common admin paths; report anything reachable without auth.

items.task: Server does not advertise its version
items.note: Trim Server, X-Powered-By and framework banners. Free information for anyone scanning.
items.recipe: Check the response for server, x-powered-by and framework banner headers.

sections.title: Files crawlers and agents look for

items.task: Each of the files above is present or consciously skipped
items.note: Especially robots.txt — a staging disallow shipped to production is the single most common launch mistake.
items.recipe: Request /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /.well-known/security.txt and /favicon.ico; check status, content type, and that robots.txt does not disallow everything.

items.task: Every URL in the sitemap is canonical and returns 200
items.note: A sitemap of redirects is the usual shape of this: the site canonicalises to a trailing slash and the sitemap omits it, or lists http:// and the site is https://. Search engines follow them, but it wastes crawl budget and hides the URLs you meant to publish.
items.recipe: Request every URL in sitemap.xml and report any that redirect, 404, or disagree with the page's own rel=canonical. Check llms.txt and any feed the same way.

items.task: No page is accidentally noindex
items.note: Check both the meta tag and the X-Robots-Tag header on the live response.
items.recipe: Check the robots meta tag and the x-robots-tag header on every page in the sitemap.

items.task: A feed is published and linked from the head
items.note: RSS or Atom for anything with posts, releases or changes. A feed nobody can discover is the same as no feed, so it needs a <link rel="alternate"> in <head> as well as a URL.
items.recipe: Request /feed.xml, /rss.xml, /atom.xml and /index.xml; check <head> for link rel=alternate. If one exists, validate it and confirm the entries match what the site publishes.

items.task: Lighthouse ≥ 90 on all four categories for key templates
items.note: Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, SEO. Home, a content page, and any conversion page at minimum.
items.recipe: Run Lighthouse under mobile throttling three times per key template; take the median of all four categories.

items.task: Core Web Vitals inside the good thresholds
items.note: LCP under 2.5s, INP under 200ms, CLS under 0.1. Lab numbers first; switch to field data from CrUX once traffic arrives.
items.recipe: Read LCP, INP and CLS from the Lighthouse run, or from CrUX field data if the site has traffic.

items.task: Caching and compression on at the edge
items.note: Brotli or gzip, long Cache-Control with hashed filenames for static assets, short or revalidated for HTML, CDN in front.
items.recipe: Check content-encoding and cache-control on the HTML and on a hashed static asset.

items.task: The critical request chain is short
items.note: Fonts preloaded and font-display: swap, no render-blocking third parties, JavaScript deferred, above-the-fold CSS inline if it helps.
items.recipe: Report render-blocking requests, unpreloaded fonts and third-party scripts in the head.

items.task: Page weight is defensible on a slow connection
items.note: Load it once on real 3G or a throttled profile. If you would not wait, neither will anyone else.
items.recipe: Total transferred bytes for a cold load of the homepage.

items.task: A performance budget is recorded in CI
items.note: Lighthouse CI or bundle-size limits, so the next change has to argue with a number rather than a memory.

items.task: Status codes verified with curl -I on production
items.recipe: Request a deep nonsense URL and confirm a 404; check the 500, 403, 410 and 503 handlers where they exist.

items.task: Error pages are styled, and work when the CDN is the thing failing
items.note: Inline the CSS on the 500 page. A stylesheet request that also fails leaves an unstyled apology.
items.recipe: Fetch the 404 page and check it carries inline styles and site navigation.

items.task: Errors are logged and someone is alerted
items.note: Client-side error tracking as well as server logs, with a threshold that reaches a human.

items.task: Unique title and meta description on every page
items.note: Roughly 55 and 155 characters. Check for duplicates across the whole crawl.
items.recipe: Crawl the sitemap and report duplicate, missing or over-length titles and meta descriptions.

items.task: Canonical URLs are absolute and self-consistent
items.note: One host wins — www or apex, not both — with 301s from the other. Trailing slashes consistent.
items.recipe: Check each canonical is absolute and self-referential, and that one of www/apex 301s to the other.

items.task: Open Graph and Twitter cards render
items.note: Absolute image URL, 1200×630, under 5MB, with a title and description. Test in a real card validator, not by eye.
items.recipe: Check og:title, og:description, and an absolute og:image that returns 200.

items.task: Structured data validates
items.note: Organization, Article, Product or BreadcrumbList through the Rich Results Test.
items.recipe: Validate the page's JSON-LD against its schema.org types.

items.task: Redirects from the old site are mapped
items.note: 301 every URL that had traffic or a backlink. Losing them is losing years of accumulated ranking.
items.recipe: Request the old site's top URLs and confirm each 301s to a live equivalent.

items.task: Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools verified
items.note: Submit the sitemap, then check the coverage report a week later.

items.task: Licence stated for content and for code
items.note: They are usually different — for example CC BY-SA for writing, MIT for the source. Say it in the footer, in LICENSE, and in the repo.
items.recipe: Look for a licence statement in the footer and a LICENSE file in the repository.

items.task: Privacy policy matches what you actually collect
items.note: Name the analytics, the embeds, the mailing list, the legal basis, and the retention period. A template policy that lists tools you don't use is worse than none.
items.recipe: List the third-party origins the site actually contacts, and compare them with what the policy names.

items.task: Cookie consent gates non-essential cookies before they are set
items.note: If you set none, say so and skip the banner. Reject must be as easy as accept.
items.recipe: Load with a fresh profile and report any cookie set before consent is given.

items.task: Terms of service, and any required company details
items.note: In the UK and EU, registered company number, address and VAT number where they apply.

items.task: You have the rights to every image, font and icon
items.note: Keep the licences and receipts somewhere findable. Web fonts in particular are licensed by pageview more often than people expect.

items.task: Third-party attributions where the licence demands them
items.note: Map tiles, open source components, photography credits.

items.task: Domain registration and auto-renew confirmed
items.note: Owned by the organisation, not by a contractor's personal account. Registrar lock on, contact address monitored.
items.recipe: Check WHOIS for the expiry date and whether the registrar lock is on.

items.task: DNS records complete, TTLs lowered before cutover
items.note: Apex and www, CAA restricting who may issue certificates, and a plan to raise TTLs again once it is stable.
items.recipe: Resolve the apex and www, and check for a CAA record.

items.task: Email authentication set up
items.note: SPF, DKIM and DMARC — including on a domain that only sends transactional mail, or your forms land in spam.
items.recipe: Query TXT records for SPF and DMARC, and the DKIM selector.

items.task: Forms and transactional email tested end to end
items.note: Submit each form on production. Confirm delivery, the reply-to address, spam filtering, validation errors and the thank-you state.

items.task: Backups exist and a restore has been tried
items.note: An untested backup is a hypothesis. Restore into a scratch environment once.

items.task: Rollback path documented and timed
items.note: Whoever is on call should know how to revert without reading the deploy tool's docs first.

items.task: Analytics installed, firing, and privacy-appropriate
items.note: Verify events in real time on production. Exclude internal traffic. Prefer a tool that doesn't require a consent banner if you can.
items.recipe: Check whether an analytics request fires on a page view, and to which origin.

items.task: Uptime monitoring with alerts that reach a person
items.note: External check, more than one region, alerting somewhere you'll see at the weekend. Add a certificate-expiry check.

items.task: Error tracking wired to the release
items.note: Source maps uploaded privately, releases tagged, so a spike points at a commit.

items.task: Conversion or goal tracking defined
items.note: Decide what success looks like now; retrofitting it loses the launch week.

sections.title: Cross-device QA and the last look

items.task: Chrome, Safari, Firefox and Edge, desktop and mobile
items.note: Include an older Safari — iOS users update at their own pace.

items.task: 320px to ultrawide, portrait and landscape
items.note: No horizontal scroll, no clipped text, tap targets at least 24×24 CSS pixels with spacing.
items.recipe: Load at 320, 768, 1280 and 2560 wide and report horizontal overflow or clipped content.

items.task: Dark mode, high contrast, and forced colours
items.note: If you ship a theme toggle, check the un-toggled system default too.
items.recipe: Render with prefers-color-scheme: dark and with forced-colors active, and compare.

items.task: Print stylesheet
items.note: Invoices, recipes, tickets, documentation. Cheap to add, obvious when missing.
items.recipe: Check for an @media print block or a print stylesheet.

items.task: JavaScript disabled or failed: the page still says something
items.note: At least core content and navigation. Also try with an aggressive ad blocker.
items.recipe: Load with JavaScript disabled and report whether the main content and navigation are still present.

items.task: Someone outside the project does a five-minute walkthrough
items.note: Give them a task, watch silently, write down where they hesitate. This finds more than the rest of the section.

sections.title: Launch day and the week after

items.task: Deploy from a clean, tagged build off the main branch
items.note: Not from a laptop with uncommitted changes. Confirm the deployed commit hash matches what you reviewed.

items.task: Re-run the automated checks against production
items.note: Headers, status codes, Lighthouse, link crawl. Configuration differs between environments more often than anyone expects.
items.recipe: Re-run every agent-checkable item in this list against the production URL.

items.task: Purge caches and confirm a cold visitor sees the new site
items.note: CDN cache, service worker, and a private window from a different network.
items.recipe: Request the homepage with a cache-busting query and compare it with a normal request.

items.task: Not launching into a Friday evening
items.note: Whoever can fix it should be awake and available for the next few hours.

items.task: Watch errors, logs and 404s for the first week
items.note: Real 404s tell you which redirects you missed. Fix them while the traffic still exists.

items.task: Diary a review date
items.note: Thirty days out: revisit analytics, accessibility, dependency updates and the things you agreed to defer.
